games.name: Classic Sonic Collection
games.summary:
Decades of classics and endless speed. Spin dash through iconic worlds, celebrate the legacy, and keep going in one epic collection of sonic adventures.

Sonic Mania
Experience classic 2D Sonic action with stunning retro inspired visuals, reimagined fan favorite zones, new bosses, and playable Sonic, tails and knuckles. Race, fly and smash your way through a nostalgic adventure with co op and competition modes.

Sonic Origins
Relive Sonic's most iconic adventures, including Sonic and the hedgehog, Sonic the Hedgehog 2, Sonic 3 and Knuckles, and Sonic CD, fully remastered in high definition. Revisit the games that launched a legend and shaped generations of Sonic fans.

Sonic Superstars
Race through classic sonic platforming reimagined with vibrant 3D visuals, new chaos emerald powers, and an all new adventure. Play as Sonic, Tails, Knuckles or Amy, team up with friends in 4 player co op, and take on Dr. Eggman and his allies across the Northstar Islands.

games.name: Climber Buddies Crazy Animals
games.summary:
Cute animals, dangerous jumps, and endless challenges.

Take control of an adorable animal and test your reflexes, precision, and determination in a challenging vertical parkour adventure. Jump across platforms, avoid dangerous traps, collect coins, and climb toward the top while every mistake threatens to send you back to the beginning.

Explore five unique worlds filled with increasingly difficult platforms, obstacles, and tricky jumps. Play solo or grab a friend for local multiplayer, where you can work together to overcome difficult sections or race against each other to see who can climb the highest. Master your movement, control every jump, and stay focused as the climb becomes more demanding.

Key Features:
• Climb Five Unique Worlds: Conquer dungeons, dark fantasy lands, castle ruins, castles, and paradise.
• Race or Team Up: Challenge a friend or work together in local multiplayer.
• Play as Cute Animals: Unlock adorable characters and unique skins.
• Master Every Jump: Use precise movement, double jumps, and aerial control.
• Collect and Customize: Gather coins and unlock new looks for your animal.

games.name: I Am Your Beast
games.summary:
I Am Your Beast is a shortform covert revenge thriller FPS about getting hunted across the North American wilderness by the military-industrial complex--and turning the tables.

You are secret agent Alphonse Harding. Retired for six years, you've been asked to complete ‘one last job’, one too many times. Declining your latest mission sets in motion a furious guerilla war between you and the Covert Operations Initiative (COI) that litters the forest with bodies and bullet casings.

Break your opponents. Use their own equipment against them. Duck into your tunnel network before enemy forces zero in on your location. Repeat.

games.name: Modern Sonic Collection
games.summary:
Three adventures and unlimited speed. Blast through alien amusement parks, rally a resistance, and explore uncharted frontiers in three epic Sonic adventures.

Sonic Forces
The evil Dr. Eggman has taken control of the world. Now you must defeat iconic old villains and fight a powerful new enemy to reclaim the world in this epic new adventure.

Sonic Colors Ultimate
Join Sonic on a high speed adventure to free the Wisps from Dr. Eggman's interstellar amusement park. Race through six vibrant worlds, harness powerful Wisp abilities, and overcome dangerous challenges.

Sonic Frontiers
In search of the missing chaos emeralds, Sonic becomes stranded on an ancient island teeming with unusual creatures. Battle hordes of powerful enemies as you explore a breathtaking world of action, adventure, and mystery.

games.name: Chico's Delivery
games.summary:
Get ready for a delicious, fun, and fast-thinking adventure in a world where every delivery needs to be perfect. In Chico’s Delivery, you control an adorable pizza-delivery bird that slides endlessly across the environment, turning every stage into a clever and irresistibly addictive puzzle.

But reaching the destination is only part of the challenge. Every table has a counter that decreases with each movement you make, creating a strategic race against time and against your own mistakes. Carefully plan your route, choose the perfect path, and figure out how to serve every table before the orders expire.

The biggest twist comes from the way Chico moves. Once he starts sliding, he only stops when he collides with a wall, obstacle, or environmental object. This turns every movement into an important decision where predicting trajectories and thinking several steps ahead becomes essential for success.

As the journey continues, new mechanics make the puzzles even more creative. Use pizza teleporters, deal with rising tables, take advantage of directional arrows, and learn how to manipulate the environment to create perfect deliveries. Every level introduces a fresh situation that demands observation, logic, and strategy.

With cute visuals, a cozy atmosphere, and clever challenges, Chico’s Delivery offers the kind of relaxing and satisfying experience that makes you want to play “just one more level.” It is the perfect balance between accessible puzzles and increasingly strategic decisions.

Perfect for fans of logic games, casual challenges, and adventures full of personality, Chico’s Delivery transforms simple pizza deliveries into a fun, charming, and surprisingly strategic journey.

Observe the stage, slide through the perfect route, and make sure no pizza arrives late.

games.name: Demons' Night Fever
games.summary:
Based on classic grid-based strategy games, this entirely new SRPG features the Peon Exploitation System - a brutal combat mechanic where you mercilessly sacrifice your own allies.

The more misdeeds you commit, the more vicious your army becomes, and the greater your advantage in battle!

Regain the lost power of the Devil, Giga Super Death, who was transformed into a baby, and crush the false god wearing a mask of justice!

games.name: Hail to the Rainbow
games.summary:
The story of a lonely young man named Ignat, who survives in the dangerous and gloomy world of post-apocalyptic cyberpunk. The few survivors of the tragic military events had to adapt to the new conditions of existence. Ignat, who lost his parents, was able to build his life alone and learned a lot in this new reality.

However, the life of the protagonist, which has already become familiar in a few years, changes dramatically when an unexpected message arrives by e-mail.

"Hail to the Rainbow" is a first-person story-driven adventure game with horror and shooter elements. In the universe of the game, you will face the dangers of a new reality, immerse yourself in the secrets of the surrounding chaos, and also relive the memories and moral torment of the protagonist. 

Explore the environment, explore electronic records and solve technical puzzles, collect items and upgrade your inventory, this will come in handy on your journey.

games.name: Solo Shift! Karaoke
games.summary: Front desk, food and drinks, cleaning—you've got to manage it all! Take on task after task all by yourself!

games.name: A Tempting Life with My Neighbor
games.summary:
Turn everyday moments with charming neighbors into a complete picture! Rotate the panels to solve tempting photo puzzles

Enjoy a photo rotation puzzle themed around exciting everyday moments with charming neighbors!

Each photo has been split into panels facing different directions. Rotate the panels and restore the original picture.

Look closely at each part of the image and compare it with the panels around it. A section that seems difficult on its own may become clear once you see how the whole picture connects.

games.name: Bottle Logic Puzzle
games.summary:
Pour, sort, and solve in Bottle Logic Puzzle!

Dive into a colorful and relaxing puzzle game where every move counts! Sort colorful liquids between bottles until each bottle contains just one color. Plan your moves carefully, think ahead, and enjoy the satisfaction of solving each puzzle.
With charming hand-drawn backgrounds, vibrant colors, and increasingly challenging levels, Bottle Logic Puzzle offers a delightful way to unwind while putting your logical thinking to the test.
Game Features:
- Colorful liquid-sorting puzzles that are easy to learn but challenging to master.
- Increasingly challenging levels that test your logic and planning skills.
- Beautiful hand-drawn backgrounds and charming visual themes.
- Simple, intuitive controls for a smooth puzzle-solving experience.
- Helpful hints when you need a little guidance.
- Relaxing gameplay with no rush — solve puzzles at your own pace.
Whether you have a few minutes to spare or want to enjoy a longer puzzle session, Bottle Logic Puzzle is a colorful little challenge for your brain!

games.name: Calcium Chaos
games.summary:
Combine unconventional items into weapons to save the world!

Skeletons are invading, and your only defense is a toaster and a chicken! Embark on a whimsical adventure through a land plagued by pesky skeletons! Uncover weird and wacky weapon synergies to fight back against the bony baddies. Along the way, you'll gather a rag-tag group of heroes who will aid you on your mission- will you have the guts to stop the necromancer's plans and save the world?

Discover an arsenal of ONE MILLION different weapon combinations, from explosive toast to homing robot chickens, and customize your loadout to suit your playstyle as you wreak havoc on your enemies.

Recruit up to four friends to join your quest to defeat the necromancer, or measure yourself by playing alone.

Transform your train into a formidable base of operations for the friends you meet along the way, buy upgrades, decorate your train, and prepare your next mission!

Dive into procedurally generated levels filled with challenges! Test your skills and adaptability as you strive to overcome the ever-growing threats that await you.

games.name: Cotton Reboot! High Tension!
games.summary:
The sequel to "Cotton Reboot!" released in 2021 is here! Will the gluttonous witch Nata de Cotton be in action again this time?

Enjoy this even more powerful and refreshing witchy shooter!

games.name: Cozy Packing
games.summary:
Pack your bags and grab your furry companions for a cozy trip!

From folding clothes into a suitcase to setting up a campsite, arranging a bakery display, building a cheese board, slicing a pizza, matching tulip colors, or piecing together a stained glass window, every scene turns everyday travel tasks into a soothing puzzle. Relax, take your time, and enjoy the little details of life on the road with the ones you love.

Key Features:
- A variety of cozy packing and sorting puzzles, from suitcases to bakery boxes and beyond
- Follow a couple and their pets through charming travel-themed scenes
- Hand-painted, warm and pastel art style
- Relaxing, no-pressure gameplay perfect for unwinding

games.name: Cult Seduction: Boys Horror Romance
games.summary:
They already picked their favorite. Thirty nights to escape, or fall completely in love with your captors.

A hooded figure meets you at the gate and welcomes you home.

The compound sits deep in the woods, lit by candlelight and old promises, and every man inside has given himself to something bigger than fear.

Each one is built around a different kind of devotion, twisted just enough to be dangerous. Some will love you. Some will test you. All of them are watching to see if you belong.

Every conversation is a choice you can't take back. Comfort the wrong one and you lose ground. Push too hard and a door closes for good. A private chat line keeps their voices in your pocket between visits, so the pressure never really stops.

The High Priest speaks softly and controls the room without raising his voice. The Fanatic would burn the whole compound down to prove his loyalty to you. The Skeptic doesn't trust outsiders, least of all one the others already adore.

And the Chosen One has thirty nights left before the ritual takes what's his, and he's decided you're the one thing worth breaking the rules for.

Moonlit courtyards, a shrine no one is supposed to enter alone, a ceremony room that only opens once. This compound was built to keep secrets, and it's starting to let you in.

games.name: Cult Seduction: Girls Horror Romance
games.summary:
They already picked their favorite. Thirty nights to escape, or fall completely in love with your captors.

A hooded figure meets you at the gate and welcomes you home.

The compound sits deep in the woods, lit by candlelight and old promises, and every woman inside has given herself to something bigger than fear.

Each one is built around a different kind of devotion, twisted just enough to be dangerous. Some will love you. Some will test you. All of them are watching to see if you belong.

games.name: DIY Dadish
games.summary: Create your own adventure and share it with the world! Everyone's favorite radish dad is back, but this time the story is up to you! in DIY Dadish gives players the ability to design any Dadish level they can imagine.

games.name: Final Fantasy Resonance
games.summary: Return to the pixel‑art world of FINAL FANTASY, evolved from its classic roots. Travel with companions bound by fate and call on Visions to aid you in battle to uncover the truth behind a force that threatens to bring everything to ruin.

games.name: Final Kick Football Legends
games.summary: Final Kick Football Legends is a Sports game, developed by Ivanovich Games and published by GS2 Games.

games.name: Gaelco Sports Collection
games.summary:
Get ready for the ultimate 90s arcade rush. This collection brings back 5 legendary, lightning-fast hits developed by the arcade masters at Gaelco. Forget complex simulations; here, it’s all about raw reflexes, immediate fun, and high-speed challenges that defined a generation of cabinet gaming.

Drive at breakneck speeds in the cult-classic isometric racers World Rally Championship and World Rally 2, where every corner requires perfect drifts against a brutal 60-second timer.

Conquer treacherous slopes in Snowboard Championship, execute precise racket strikes in Squash, and dominate the sand with fierce smashes in Touch and Go.

It’s a pure dopamine rush straight from the golden age of arcades.

games.name: Glasses Waifu: Cozy Spot the Difference
games.summary:
Take a cozy break with cute glasses girls

Ready for a relaxing little puzzle break?

Enjoy charming illustrations of laid-back girls who look great in glasses, from quiet reading time to relaxing at a café or taking a nap. Compare the two pictures and find the subtle difference hiding among the details.

How to play:
・Look closely at the two pictures side by side
・Find one spot in the picture on the right that differs from the left
・Tap the difference to clear the puzzle

The simple rules make it easy to enjoy, even if you are new to puzzle games. It is perfect for a quick break, a little downtime, or whenever you want to slow down and relax.

A great fit for:
・Players who love cute girls with glasses
・Fans of cozy, soothing illustrations
・Spot-the-difference fans
・Anyone looking for a quick casual game
・Players who want to test their observation skills

Take your time admiring each girl’s expressions and gestures, or race to find the answer as quickly as you can. Enjoy a relaxing solo session, or turn the search into a fun challenge for a livestream audience.

games.name: Heart-Pounding Office Puzzle with My Boss
games.summary:
Enjoy a light, heart-pounding office life with a boss who always seems to set the pace, all through an easygoing puzzle game!

Whether you are in work mode or taking a quick break, somehow you are never quite in control. Take on a variety of office-themed situations and enjoy the little thrills that unfold as you play.

games.name: Heart-Pounding! Uniform Montage Puzzle ~From After School to the Office~
games.summary:
Hey, got a minute? A girl in uniform stops you cold. A heart-pounding montage puzzle

What would you do if a girl in uniform suddenly caught your attention?

From the walk home after school to the bustle of the office, everyday moments take on a thrilling twist.

Meet charming characters in school uniforms, work outfits, and all kinds of stylish attire in this heart-pounding montage puzzle.

Putting the look together is easy!
・Study the character's appearance
・Compare the mixed-up outfit strips
・Choose the right combination and complete the look!

A student in a school uniform. A confident professional in office wear. Each completed montage brings a fresh, exciting encounter.

“Is this the right piece?”
“Maybe this one fits better…”

Compare the details and find the perfect match. Completing the look is incredibly satisfying!

games.name: IQ Cross Logic: Spot the Pattern, Solve the Puzzle
games.summary:
Can you spot both patterns?

Rows and columns of numbers may look random, but hidden rules are waiting to be found. Can you identify the number piece that satisfies both patterns?

This reasoning puzzle is easy to learn and satisfying to solve. Study the arrangement and use the numbers and their positions as clues.

How to play:
• Work out the pattern across the row
• Work out the pattern down the column
• Choose the piece that matches both conditions and move it to the crossing square

Knowledge is not the key—observation and insight are. Begin with two-digit numbers, then take on three-digit challenges as the stages progress.

There are 40 stages to complete. Think through each puzzle at your own pace and ask yourself: what rule is hiding in this sequence?

Stuck on a puzzle? Use a hint to keep moving, even if logic puzzles are new to you.

Perfect for anyone who enjoys number puzzles, logic challenges, pattern spotting, brain training, or a quick solo game for a spare moment.

The answer cannot be found by looking across or down alone. Can you uncover the solution where both patterns meet?

games.name: Match & Crush! Aqua Park Beauties
games.summary:
Can you complete the aqua park photo?

Sparkling water, colorful water-park scenery, and charming moments with beautiful women.

Set in a lively aqua park, this photo rotation puzzle game lets you enjoy casual expressions and natural poses in every completed image.

Spin the scrambled panels and bring each appealing photo back together.

・Look closely at how the panels connect
・Rotate each panel to restore the picture
・Clear stages that get trickier as you go

The rules are simple, but spotting the right flow of the image takes observation and a little spark of intuition.

Finish each puzzle and enjoy a quick, heart-fluttering moment by the water.
Ready to relax at the aqua park and put the photos back in place?

games.name: Megalopolis SOS
games.summary:
City Defense Shooter: Protect the World from the UFO Invasion! Defend our cities from the alien swarm.

Retro Arcade Action: Defend the World!
Originally released in 1983, this classic shooter puts you in command of global defense. Maneuver your turret left and right, launching bullets and floating mines to intercept relentless UFO attacks.

Clear each stage by destroying a set number of enemies. But beware—the mission ends if you lose all your lives or if every city under your protection is leveled.

Six iconic cities stand between you and the invaders: NYC, LON, TKY, MOW, PEK, and PAR. Be careful—dodging a bullet might mean letting a city take the hit instead. The secret to victory? Stay on the offensive! To minimize damage and save the world, you must take the fight to them.

games.name: Moadra
games.summary: Endure... Evolve... or die. Embrace the unknown and traverse a vast alien world riddled with bizarre creatures, deadly hazards, and grim mysteries. Seek redemption, and confront the terrifying sin buried in the depths of the forgotten planet Protea VI.

games.name: No Exit 9
games.summary:
Something has changed. Find the anomaly before it finds you.

You are trapped in a place that looks familiar—but something is wrong.

Walk through a series of mysterious corridors and search for anomalies hidden in the environment. A painting may change. A door may appear where it shouldn't. A light may behave strangely. Something that was there before may suddenly be gone.

Pay attention to every detail.

If you spot an anomaly, turn back. If everything looks normal, keep moving forward. One wrong decision could send you deeper into the loop.

No Exit 9 features nine challenging levels, each filled with subtle changes, unsettling details, and unexpected events. The deeper you go, the harder it becomes to tell what is real and what has changed.

There is no map. No guide. No second chance to ignore what you see.

Observe your surroundings, remember what was there before, and trust your instincts.

Can you identify every anomaly and find your way out?

games.name: ONE PIECE: Grand Gourmet
games.summary: Hop aboard a delectable management sim in the world of ONE PIECE! Work alongside the Straw Hat Crew to build the greatest floating restaurant of the seas. Collect ingredients, dream up dishes, and decorate to have familiar faces lining up for more!

games.name: Press! Support! The Heartwarming Kemomimi Cafe
games.summary:
They don't charge a fee! They just want to make you swoon with *moe*! I just want to "stan" a bunny café like that!

A "Nyan-tuber" (cat-themed YouTuber) has gone undercover—camera in hand—at the rumored "Nagomi-juu Mimi Cafe" (Soothing Animal-Eared Cafe)!

Three different types of bunny girls work there.
It is a game where you are served by each of them individually and simply find yourself "soothed" while listening to them talk.

games.name: Reversi Brain Quiz! - Spot the Max Flip in 1-Move -
games.summary:
Where can you flip the most?

How many discs can you flip with a single move?

Take a close look at the board and find the spot that lets you flip the most discs in this Reversi-inspired brain teaser.

The rules are simple!
• Study the board
• Check the available spots
• Choose the spot where you think you can flip the most discs

Look in every direction—vertical, horizontal, and diagonal—to find the best move.

You may think, “This is it!” But a closer look could reveal another spot that flips even more.

Enjoy the fun of reading the board in a Reversi-style thinking puzzle designed for quick, casual play.

Recommended for players who enjoy:
• Reversi and board games
• Brain teasers and logic puzzles
• Testing observation and intuition
• Quick games
• A little mental exercise during spare moments

Don’t miss a spot on the board. Find the one move that brings the biggest haul!

games.name: Slot & Learn Easy English Words
games.summary:
Just starting to learn English?

This easygoing learning game helps beginners practice familiar English words in a fun, game-like way.

Look at each question and discover how to say everyday things and commonly used words in English.

Playing is simple!
• Read the question carefully
• Think of the right English word
• Choose an answer and take on the question

Start with basic vocabulary instead of difficult material. It’s a friendly first step for anyone who wants to begin learning English.

Ever seen a word and thought, “I know that—but how do you say it in English?” Check words one at a time and get comfortable with English while you play.

Easy to pick up in short sessions, it’s great for a little daily practice, as well as previewing and reviewing English vocabulary.

Recommended for people who want to:
• Start learning English
• Build a foundation with basic words
• Find a game that’s an easy introduction to English study
• Practice English in a relaxed, game-like way

games.name: Slot & Learn My Faves Hangul
games.summary:
Can you place the right Hangul?

Ever recognize a word but forget how it looks in Hangul?

Turn the words you see in your fan life into a fun way to learn Korean!

This fill-in-the-blank Korean quiz game uses illustrations to help you complete Hangul words. Start with words connected to the things you love and get familiar with Korean one letter at a time.

How to play:
• Look at the illustration and the partially completed word.
• Choose the Hangul character that fits from four options.
• Place the character in the blank to complete the word.
• Compare similar-looking characters and find the perfect one.

Scenes from cheering at a live show, fan events, and dance choreography bring each word to life. Even familiar words can feel fresh when you see them written in Hangul.

Whether you love K-pop or are just starting to explore Korean, each question is easy to try in a spare moment. Turn “I’ve seen that!” into “Now I get it!” and add a little Korean learning to your fan time.

games.name: Solitaire Realms - Horror
games.summary:
A classical Solitaire game with a spine-chilling twist. Play classic Solitaire in an eerie, haunted world.

This game combines timeless Solitaire gameplay with a dark, atmospheric presentation filled with moody colors, haunting scenes, and creatures that lurk in the shadows.

Play classic Klondike Solitaire in 1-card or 3-card draw mode, focusing on clean moves, smart decisions, and a satisfying flow. Each completed game rewards you with score and experience, based on how efficiently you play.

As you gain experience, you level up and unlock cosmetic rewards. These include chilling horror-themed card skins, atmospheric backgrounds inspired by abandoned mansions, foggy graveyards, and candlelit crypts, and stylish card backs. Every single card has multiple skins and can be customized individually.

Before each match, you can freely adjust your deck and table to match your mood. Whether you prefer eerie dark tones, detailed gothic illustrations, or a more minimal look, every game feels personal and relaxing.

With no time pressure and a steady sense of progression, the game offers hours of soothing gameplay and a constantly growing collection of beautiful cards.

games.name: Toxic or Safe? Dr. Poison's Dangerous Quiz
games.summary:
Can you spot what’s poisonous?

Cute or creepy, nature can be full of surprises. Can you tell what may be poisonous and what is safe?

This casual two-choice quiz challenges your knowledge and instincts with images inspired by animals, plants, mushrooms, and other natural curiosities.

・Look closely at each image
・Choose whether it is poisonous or not

Don’t let a cute appearance or a scary look fool you. Every question is a chance to test what you know, discover surprising facts, and sharpen your nature knowledge.

It’s easy to pick up for a quick mental refresh, and fun to play with friends or an audience by guessing the answer together. Ready to become a poison expert?

games.name: Veggie Warfare - Haunted Harvest
games.summary:
Survive the haunted killer vegetables!

When the harvest moon rises, the crops come alive.
Blast through endless waves of possessed vegetables in this fast-paced rogue-like FPS! Collect upgrades, survive twisted cornfields and cursed barns, and fight your way through the Haunted Harvest before the fields claim you.

games.name: Youth Assemble! High School Girl Montage
games.summary:
Can you line up every team?

How many club stars can you bring together?

Remember those school days when every team had its own style? This charming montage puzzle brings the energy of high school activities to life with colorful illustrations of girls devoted to their clubs.

Each picture is split into three horizontal panels. Slide the panels into place and assemble the club girl shown by the prompt.

games.name: Zumba - Monster Marble Madness
games.summary:
Haunt the halls—match, blast, and spook your way through marble madness!

Zumba – Monster Marble Madness invites you to roam a haunted manor as a playful ghost with a mouth full of colorful, spooky marbles. Choose a level, float to the center of the crypt’s winding corridors, and launch your marbles to match three or more identical orbs before they vanish past the spirit threshold. Create ghastly chain reactions, clear waves with precision timing, and earn up to three stars per stage by preventing any marble from escaping into the beyond.

Every ten levels reveal a new haunted realm—Phantom Foyer, Cobwebbed Corridor, Moonlit Mausoleum, and the Shadowed Sanctum—each with unique marble hues, twisting pathways, moving spectral barriers, and ever-increasing speeds.

games.name: Omni Growth
games.summary: The last hope of your species. Consume your prey, evolve, and turn an abandoned galactic ship into your personal hunting grounds as you become a deadly predator.

games.name: Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest
games.summary: Create your own Warrior Cat and journey through the Lake Territories in an immersive action-adventure inspired by the beloved Warrior Cats book series. Hunt, explore, battle rival Clans, uncover prophecies, and shape your legacy with every choice you make.

games.name: Sunshine Farm
games.summary:
Sunshine Farm is a farming simulator with shop management.

Grow your farm, explore a vast world, expand the fair, and run a successful store.

games.name: 9 R.I.P. sequel
games.summary:
The previous work, "9 RIP," weaves the story of a bizarre love and the supernatural encounters in the afterlife. In this "9 RIP sequel," you can enjoy the continuation of the story.

The work begins with the two endings from the previous work. The main content, "Heaven Edition," which takes place after "Final Act: Heaven," is a sequel that depicts a new horror.

The sub-content, "God Edition," which takes place after "Final Act: God," is a fan disc that leads to a sweet and happy ending.

Please look forward to the various strange worlds and the fate of the strange characters and the love that is woven once again.

games.name: Dog Man: Bark in Action
games.summary:
Join Dog Man and his Supa Buddies for a supa-new adventure! A comic-book style game packed with action, humor, boss fights, and ability-granting gadgets. Play as 10 different characters from the comics, each with unique powers.

A hero is needed! Dr. Scum has set up Hypno Screens around the city, mind-controlling the innocent townsfolk. Now it’s up to Dog Man - part Dog, part Man- to fight back against Dr. Scum and all his minions. Defeat Dr. Scum, save your friends, and rescue the city!

games.name: Village in the Shade
games.summary:
From the development team behind the Yomawari series, Hono Gurashi no Niwa is a life simulation game set in a nostalgic rural village.

Farm and take care of livestock, enjoy activities like fishing and hunting, and deepen your relationships with the other villagers…

Your nostalgic and heartwarming rural life begins.

games.name: Fallen City Brawl
games.summary:
As a brutal battle for control of Fallen City's criminal underworld rages, four strangers join forces to survive and reclaim the streets! With a ferocious wolf at their sides, these unlikely allies will face impossible odds. Along the way, motivations and past lives will collide, further testing their loyalty as well as their fighting skills. Only by binding together can they reach the final showdown that will decide who lives and who falls.

Inspired by arcade beat 'em ups of the late '80s and early '90s, Fallen City Brawl is a story of ambition and revenge told through intense side-scrolling pixel art action.

games.name: Gennady
games.summary: Gennady is a dynamic roguelike platformer, where you must fight your way through shifting corridors filled with chthonic creatures, and death only makes you stronger. All wrapped in the legendary absurdity and classic animation inspired by the era of Earthworm Jim.

games.name: SULFUR
games.summary:
Descend the depths of Sulfur in this action-adventure, combining first person shooter mechanics with role-playing elements. Make important choices to survive battles and explore a world of intense and brutal combat. 수

Plan ahead, outsmart enemies and progress a world of dark creatures and cunning evil. Utilize playful and tactile weaponry in visceral and intense combat. Create unique builds by combining weapons, gear, tools, and enchantments to suit your playstyle.Whether you’re a gun-blazing risk-taker or a careful strategist, the choice is yours. 

Adapt your approach, experiment, and survive the dangers of Sulfur.

games.name: Croc 2 Kingdom of the Gobbos
games.summary: Croc's back, and this time he's searching for his long-lost parents. Revived by the Dantinis, arch enemy Baron Dante vows revenge. Explore four mainland villages, rescue Gobbos, and battle new Guardians. Race cars and speedboats, ride minecarts, and take to the skies in the remastered 1999 classic.

games.name: Hello Kitty Party Land
games.summary: Join the party at Party Land and team up with beloved Sanrio characters to play together in a variety of exciting mini games. Meet over 145 beloved characters and collect their stickers! Team up with one of 16 playable Sanrio characters and play as your own avatar or your favorite teammate. Jump into 45+ mini games with friends, either offline or online. Try Board Game mode, and keep the fun going with quick mini games while you wait for your turn.  Create a character that’s uniquely yours! Customize everything from hairstyles to outfits, and unlock even more items as you progress through the game.

games.name: Hokko Spaces
games.summary: Hokko Spaces is a calm, casual sandbox that gives you fun tools to create beautiful, lively spaces inhabited by adorable characters. Unlock cute residents and watch them hang out, do some gardening, and enjoy the spaces you build for them. No rules, no stress, just cozy dioramas and chill vibes.

games.name: Joe & Mac Retro Collection
games.summary:
Developed by Red Art Studios, Red Art Games' internal development studio, the Joe & Mac Retro Collection is a compilation of Joe & Mac: Caveman Ninja, Congo's Caper, and Joe & Mac 2: Lost in the Tropics, the three Joe & Mac titles developed by Data East and released on Super Nintendo between 1991 and 1995. 

In addition to allowing players to rediscover the original games as they were presented back in the 90s, the Joe & Mac Retro Collection also features numerous quality of life improvements!

games.name: Pardon My French Toast
games.summary:
Welcome to the Jam Session Cruise! Lucky you, you just happened to stumble across a ticket for a lovely vacation at sea! At least, until you discover that this boat can barely float!

Pardon My French Toast is a 3D platformer starring a slice of toast who covers himself in sweet spreads to get fun abilities.

Explore dozens of levels and find huge candies to fuel the boat. From fruity cakes to tropical jungles to haunted floating islands (and more!), get bready for some tasty sights!

You're not alone on this cruise; lots of other toasts are along for the ride! Get to know them: they’ve all got a good reason for being there. Maybe you can help them?

games.name: Souls of Bombarika
games.summary: A lone ghost battles deadly Ghost Bosses threatening humanity. Possess objects, solve reality-bending puzzles, and uncover an emotional mother-son story.

games.name: STEINS;GATE RE:BOOT
games.summary:
Scenarios with Improved Readability
Based on the scenario from STEINS;GATE ELITE, the story has been refined to be more evenly paced, with an overall smoother reading experience. Along with new dialogue and narrative text, a brand-new worldline and ending scenario have been added, bringing players a story never before seen. The game features a substantially expanded volume of text, delivering a richer story experience.

Newly Recorded Voices and Sound
All in-game voice lines have been newly recorded in Japanese, while the entire soundtrack has been remade by Composer Tsuyoshi Abo.

Revamped Graphics
All character art, backgrounds, and event still images have been completely redrawn from scratch, resulting in a major visual revamp. Compared to the original Xbox 360 version, the number of event still images has approximately doubled, while the number of background visuals has increased by roughly 20%. The expanded volume of artwork delivers an even more immersive experience.

games.name: The Last Cat in the Universe
games.summary: Gather the remains of a dying space station to build a cozy home for the last cat in the universe. A short, narrative-driven incremental game about finding peace in the face of darkness

games.name: The Transference
games.summary: Jump into an escape room set in a deranged mind and experience a first-person exploration game in a chilling new dimension. Shift between three perspectives and attempt to unravel the mystery hiding in this mind-bending psychological thriller. Project yourself into a riveting narrative experience and become immersed in an unsettling psychological thriller. Piece together a family's mystery as you recover fragmented memories from the corrupted consciousness of each perspective. In this first-person narrative mystery, you must explore the walls of the family's home to interpret events and discover the truth. Playable in VR and non-VR modes.

games.name: The Zibbo Show
games.summary:
The lights are on. The audience is going crazy. And tonight, YOU are the star of the show!

Progress through 12 rounds of increasingly dangerous opponents, build a new strategy every run, and face Zibbo himself in the in the grand finale! If you make it that far.

You and your opponent each have a 3×3 board and nine dice. Take turns placing one die at a time. Matching values in a column multiplies your score, and placing the right dice opposite an enemy column destroys their dice. Every placement is a decision full of luck, strategy, and the occasional regret. The crowd loves it either way!

Before each match, place a bet. Win and you double it. Lose and it’s gone, though honestly, losing the money is the part you’ll think about the least.

Between matches, visit the shop to collect cards, upgrade your dice, and stock up on chips. Cards trigger automatically and stack in ways you don’t always see coming. When the right pieces come together , the score explodes in ways that feel very, very good.

Every run unlocks new cards to discover and new combinations to try. With 48 cards to collect across runs, there’s always something you haven’t seen yet.

games.name: Titanium Court
games.summary:
Welcome to Titanium Court! Table for one? You have a reservation I assume? You don’t!? Ah, I see. Just minding your own business before stumbling into a realm of magic and faeries, were you? Not to worry, happens all the time. Tell you what, why don’t I see if we can squeeze you in somewhere while you become acquainted with the many amenities offered by the Court.

Amenities such as:

    Puzzling Battles: For tonight's entertainment, the Court is at WAR! Just a little something to pass the time, you see. Who's in command? Why do you ask? Are you volunteering? Oh don't worry, you won't be issuing orders to these faerie troops. They wouldn't follow them anyways. I think you'll have more success commanding the terrain itself to fall in your favor, haha.

    Puzzling Narrative: Lore dumps are strictly against my religion I'm afraid, so you'll have to uncover the secrets of the Court yourself. Some of them may even fundamentally change you as a person. Be careful with those!

    Diverse and fulfilling career options: Warlord, Arsonist, Celebrity, Insurance Fraudster. Your time within the Court will qualify you for many of these exalted and lucrative positions.

    A vast collection of fine art to-wait, what's this?

games.name: Tom the Postgirl
games.summary: Join Tom, the village’s new postgirl, and get to know the locals, perhaps a little too well. Her method, although controversial, is highly effective: intense, obsessive stalking.

games.name: Asylum
games.summary: Use waves of monsters to overcome the tower defence and escape the asylum.

games.name: Blasphemous: Martyrs' Edition
games.summary: The Martyr’s Limited Edition includes the complete Blasphemous game with all expansions, along with a visual compendium featuring iconic artwork, a printed manual, an exclusive art print, a personal letter from the development team, and a digital code to download the full soundtrack.

games.name: Bobo and the Chest of Nightmares
games.summary: Jump, glide, and outsmart traps in this spooky 3D platformer! Smash obstacles, solve puzzles, and fend off evil spirits to defeat The Dream Master. Collect hidden treasures and restore joy to a world shrouded in darkness!

games.name: Goodboy Galaxy
games.summary:
With his home world on the brink of ecological collapse, Maxwell bravely hopped into his experimental ship in dogged pursuit of a solution.

Beyond the point of no return, holding out forlorn hope, he finds himself stranded - thousands of lightyears from home, at the edge of a hostile galaxy.

Help Maxwell explore unfamiliar worlds, make strange new friends and contend with mysterious forces.

Goodboy Galaxy is a game in development for Game Boy Advance, PC and Nintendo Switch. It's an exploration focused platform game similar to Metroid or Cave Story.

games.name: Pinballoid Crush
games.summary: In Pinballoid Crush, classic pinball evolves into an arcade experience with adventure and strategy elements.

games.name: The Cat in the Hat: Rainy Day Mayhem
games.summary: The Cat in the Hat once said, “It is fun to have fun, but you have to know how.” Everyone from the mischievous Dr. Seuss classic is here. Become smart and steady Sally, energetic wild card Johnny, cause double the trouble as Thing 1 and Thing 2 or be cheerful Little Cat A. And of course, the chaos conductor, The Cat in the Hat and anxiously wise Fish will be there to help, on this zany ride. Play solo or go against your friends, choosing from two trick-filled game modes. Fancy a game of chase? Then “Find the Cat” will have you turning the house upside down looking for The Cat in the Hat. Or maybe you prefer getting into chaotic challenges? See how quickly you can capture penguins, decorate a cake, and who knows what else in the 18 minigames you can choose from. But the fun doesn’t stop there, just like The Cat’s hat, it’ll be full of tricks. With varying difficulty levels, long challenges and short, there’s something for everyone. Get ready for your house to be filled with giggles, groans, and glorious mayhem.

games.name: Yet Another Zombie Survivors
games.summary:
The Horde is coming but you're ready to fight it! 

Assemble your team and decide upon their enhancements to find the most efficient synergies against thousands of the undead. Survive. Then evolve. Then break all the limits in this deceivingly simple but addictive reverse bullet hell.

games.name: Fuga: Melodies of Steel 1 / 2 / 3
games.summary:
Introducing the Trilogy Box, a set of three packaged versions of the "Senjou no Fuga" series and luxurious goods!

The long-awaited package version of the trilogy of the dramatic simulation RPG "Fuga of the Battlefield" series with the themes of war, revenge, and beasts is now available!

The Nintendo Switch package, Taranis Metal Figure, art book, and soundtrack will be delivered in a special box.

games.name: HorrorVale
games.summary:
Welcome to HorrorVale! Your next door neighbors are zombies, reanimated monsters deliver the mail and ghosts hide out in your bathroom. Join Alice as she journeys through the underworld on a quest to save her zombie Dog, Scruffy from strange and unusual monsters that have suddenly invaded the once peaceful town of HorrorVale.

HorrorVale is a traditional RPG adventure game inspired by horror, full of unexpected twists and turns.

games.name: Neverway
games.summary:
After Fiona quits her job, she starts over on a farm and becomes the immortal herald of a dead god. 

Keep your life from falling apart while searching for Neverway, a nightmare reality that is slowly leaking into yours.

Neverway features a top-down, fast-paced combat with an emphasis on player expression. Craft items to customize your playstyle, and unlock combat abilities through your friendship bonds.

Farm and craft items, prepare meals, or just decorate your homestead. Time progresses in three blocks, and you choose when to advance: morning, afternoon, and evening. One day at a time.

games.name: Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered
games.summary:
The ultimate kaiju arena brawler is back, completely remastered. From Atari and original developer, Pipeworks, Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered updates the 2002 fighter with enhanced visuals and quality of life improvements. 

Choose your monster and battle it out with a range of brutal attacks through 8 locations, each with day and night variations. Battle through real-world cities, Monster Island, and the alien Mothership. Face off against your friends in local co-op or new online multiplayer.

Master your skills in cinematic kaiju vs. kaiju battles through familiar cities. Every monster has a distinctive moveset that makes each brawl unique, from vicious melee attacks to ranged energy blasts to special Rage Mode strikes. Tired of throwing punches? Why not throw a skyscraper, instead? The arenas are not just passive locations, and instead allow you to use the environment strategically in combat and even weaponize buildings and other landmarks.

games.name: Let's Sing 2027
games.summary:
Grab the mic - or your smartphone - and get ready to shine! The karaoke game Let's Sing 2027 transforms any occasion into a musical celebration with a brand-new playlist of chart-toppers and classics. Sing solo for high scores or team up with friends and family for unforgettable parties and performances.

Featuring songs with their original music videos, adjustable vocal guide settings, and easy-to-use smartphone and mic support, Let's Sing 2027 makes singing accessible, fun, and endlessly replayable. 

Whether you're hosting a party or chasing your best score, it's your turn to take center stage with the ultimate karaoke game!

games.name: Outbreak: Dead City
games.summary: Survive as a soldier sent to suppress the zombie threat and find a vaccine to save humanity! Outbreak: Dead City is a cinematic narrative first-person shooter presented in low-poly 3D style.

games.name: Eternal Palace Sakura
games.summary: Sharpen your blades and step into the Eternal Palace Sakura, a dream labyrinth haunted by restless yokai. Battle through ever-shifting realms in this anime-inspired 3D action roguelite, mastering fluid combat and exploring endless floors of the palace!

games.name: Faraway
games.summary: You are a shooting star that refuses its fate of disappearing in the ether, to instead go travel space and draw constellations through its journey. Faraway is a one-button game, with a simple set of rules finely balanced to adapt to different playing levels, within an always renewed universe that is procedurally generated in real time - based on score -, resulting in an infinitely replayable game. Like Steph Thirion's first game Eliss, Faraway is set in a bizarre and lonely outer space, was 100% created - design, coding, music and sound - by one person, and all its graphics are drawn by code, resulting in a rarely personal sensory experience.

games.name: K-POP Rising: Dream to Shine
games.summary: In K-POP Rising: Dream to Shine, players immerse themselves in the demanding and fascinating world of modern music. Accompanied by their best friend Nova, they will need to commit 100 percent to the race for stardom: from intensive training sessions in the studio to the ultimate recognition on the most prestigious stages, the title offers a complete experience combining a sense of rhythm, deep customization, and community management in the era of social media.

games.name: Kingdom of Night
games.summary:
One night, in 1987, in the small town of Miami, Arizona, a satanic cult unwittingly summons the ancient evil, Baphomet, catapulting the town into chaos. John, awoken by the kidnapping of his neighbor, sets out into the night to fight back against the demonic invasion and rescue his friends before it's too late...

Take control of John as his adventure leads him through an hour-by-hour experience of what could be everyone's last night on Earth. As John, you will encounter unearthly evils, Demon lords, afflicted townsfolk, high school bullies, and a torrent of engaging, serial-like side stories - all nested in a larger-than-life fantasy that brings the ultimate evil to a neighborhood near you.

Choose your class, customize your abilities, and battle nightmarish creatures as you collect unique gear in order to infiltrate the massive lairs of Demon lords that have taken over the town.

games.name: MANIC MINER
games.summary:
Experience a milestone in video game history in a completely reimagined version! 

Authorized by original developer Matthew Smith, this reboot of the 1983 classic combines the distinctive and challenging gameplay of MANIC MINER with modern graphics, improved controls, newly arranged music, and extensive historical bonus content.

Step back into the role of miner Willy and take on 20 legendary levels filled with deadly creatures, clever jumps, and tricky obstacles. Collect all the items before your oxygen runs out and master one of the most challenging platformers of all time.

games.name: Next of Kin: Epiphany
games.summary:
Do you have what it takes to catch "The Epiphany Killer"?

Step into the world of "Next of Kin: Epiphany," where you become private detective Dennis Monroe, a relentless investigator driven to catch the infamous "Epiphany Killer," a shadowy figure who has haunted the city for over twenty years. Every clue draws you closer to the truth, but danger lurks behind every revelation.

In the thrilling conclusion to the "Next of Kin" trilogy, you'll explore atmospheric locations, interrogate suspects with the powerful new "Expose" system, and unravel the chilling truth behind the notorious "Epiphany Killer".

games.name: Hasbro Games Junior Collection
games.summary:
Get ready for a big, colorful game night full of laughs, surprises, and “just one more turn!” moments! This collection brings 3 classic junior board games to life in one exciting video game made for kids and families.

Race around the board in Monopoly Jr., where every dice roll can help you grab cool places, collect money, and become the last player standing. Put on your detective hat in Clue Jr. as you search for clues, cross off suspects, and solve the case before anyone else! Then jump into The Game of Life Jr., spin the spinner, drive your car along the path, and collect stars as you go.

Play on your own or in local multiplayer for up to 4 players on one console. Create your own adorable avatar and make it truly yours with fun customization options and unlock new looks and cosmetic rewards just by playing matches.

Easy to learn and packed with exciting moments every round, it’s perfect for family game nights, friendly competition, and big smiles from start to finish!

games.name: Pretty Girls Game Collection V
games.summary:
The latest entry in the popular compilation series brings together four fan-favourite Pretty Girls titles in one value-packed retail release, offering players a diverse selection of puzzle and casual gameplay experiences paired with the charming anime-style presentation that fans have come to expect from the franchise.

Each of the four games has been enhanced with exclusive naughty content, that fans of the series have become accustomed to, amounting to a wealth of new images direct from the Japanese creators that would otherwise not have been possible to release on console even in their home country, making this essential and definitive.

games.name: Hillthorn
games.summary:
Only the foolish and the desperate attempt to wander the mazelike trails of Hillthorn. Even those who know their way may still stumble upon dangerous wildlife or a local villager’s piercing gaze. 

But a child has gone missing, time is in short supply, and you’re the one being tasked with unraveling the mountain’s secrets. 

Welcome to Hillthorn, a dark investigation game unlike any other, where the mystery unfolds without a single word spoken.

games.name: MARVEL Cosmic Invasion: The Siege of Castle Doom
games.summary: Welcome to MARVEL Cosmic Invasion - The Siege of Castle Doom, the second expansion of MARVEL Cosmic Invasion, which includes two new playable characters and a new game mode. Equipped with high-powered tech armor of his own design, along with occult skills and his genius intellect, Doctor Doom is the biggest threat in the universe... and Annihilus definitely won't be up to the challenge. Cosmic rays have given archeologist and explorer Susan Storm massive light-bending powers and force field manipulation. She now fights for the survival of the galaxy as The Invisible Woman, bringing in never-seen-before abilities to MARVEL Cosmic Invasion.

games.name: Warhammer Survivors
games.summary:
Warhammer Survivors is a fast-paced roguelite survivors' game, pitting a host of iconic Warhammer characters against endless hordes of enemies from multiple Warhammer factions. 

Developed by Auroch Digital (Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun) in partnership with Warhammer and poncle (Vampire Survivors), discover the universes of Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer: Age of Sigmar in all its pixel glory in this new surviv-a-ton.

games.name: Castlebound
games.summary:
Castlebound is a thrilling roguelike action game where you and your allies must defend a walking castle while battling relentless waves of monstrous foes.

Join Lenora, a skilled archer, and her wise grandfather Vargus as they awaken an ancient structure that transforms into a living fortress.

Guided by the enigmatic Coronya, they must gather powerful warriors to fight the malevolent forces threatening the realm.

games.name: Prinny Party: Going Overboard!
games.summary: Get your friends together for Prinny Party: Going Overboard! In this party game, you’ll traverse the board as you take down demons, earn experience, and buy new equipment—all to make sure you’re strong enough to defeat the Supreme Overboard!

games.name: BALL x PIT: Risen Ballbylon
games.summary:
You’re used to the lift descending into the depths of the pit – but now it’s going up. In this massive expansion for smash hit ball-bouncing roguelite BALL x PIT, rise above the abyss to reach Risen Ballbylon, which floats high in the sky above. Each level is a layer of the former city, where the population has been warped by the effects of the meteor.

Risen Ballbylon is the biggest and most transformative expansion for BALL x PIT yet, adding a wealth of new characters, balls, passives, enemies, bosses, buildings, and levels, dramatically expanding the possibilities of a run and introducing fresh new gameplay mechanics to test even the most hardened veterans of the pit. Will you rise to the challenge?

games.name: Moomin: Midsummer Madness
games.summary:
Moomin: Midsummer Madness is a delightfully playful point-and-click adventure inspired by Tove Jansson’s cherished Nordic fantasy novel, Moominsummer Madness. 

Play as Moomintroll and Little My as they explore a curious old theatre caught in a great flood. The journey will be filled with endearing encounters, familiar faces, and a touch of mischief.

games.name: Lost Sock Simulator 3000
games.summary: Be a sweetheart and help Gertrude Knitmore find all her lost socks. An idle clicker about humanity's oldest unsolved mystery. And yes, there's an ending. The universe has opinions about your sock collection.

games.name: Reverie in the Moonlight
games.summary: In Reverie in the Moonlight, scary monsters are chasing you, and you can’t fight them...but your plushies can. Can your adorable friends protect you from these nightmares?
